Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 1) Abrasion is best defined as:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Abrasion is superficial skin loss due to friction or scraping. Epidermis is removed and scab formation occurs.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 2) Bruise is caused by:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Bruise or contusion is caused by blunt force. Blood collects under intact skin without external skin breach.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 3) The key differentiating feature of lacerated wound is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Laceration is produced by blunt force tearing. Irregular torn margin with tissue bridges is characteristic.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 4) Incised wound usually has:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Incised wound is caused by a sharp cutting weapon. It has clean-cut margins and length is usually more than depth.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 5) Stab wound is characterized by:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Stab wound is produced by a sharp pointed weapon. External wound may be small but depth is greater than length.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 6) Chop wound is caused by:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Chop wound is caused by a heavy sharp weapon. It produces deep gaping injury and may cut or fracture bone.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 7) Firearm wound means:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Firearm wound is produced by bullet or gunshot. It may have entry wound with or without exit wound.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 8) The usual cause of abrasion is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Abrasion results from friction or scraping of skin. It removes superficial epidermis and forms a scab.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 9) In bruise, the skin is usually:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: In bruise or contusion, blood is present under intact skin. There is no open wound.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 10) Lacerated wound is produced by:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Laceration is due to tearing by blunt force. It has irregular margins and tissue bridges.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 11) Incised-looking wound is commonly produced by:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Incised-looking wound may appear clean-cut but is actually a laceration. It occurs when blunt force acts over a bony area.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 12) A true incised wound has:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: True incised wound has clean-cut margins and no tissue bridge. Tissue bridges suggest laceration.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 13) Scab formation is classically seen in:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Abrasion removes the epidermis and later forms a scab. It is a superficial injury.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 14) Blood under intact skin is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Bruise or contusion is collection of blood under intact skin. It is caused by blunt force.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 15) Bone cut or fracture is most suggestive of:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Chop wound is produced by a heavy sharp weapon. It may cause deep injury with bone cut or fracture.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 16) In firearm injury, the exit wound is usually:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: In firearm injury, exit wound is usually larger than entry wound. Entry wound may show abrasion collar.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 17) Abrasion collar is associated with:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Abrasion collar may be present around the entry wound of firearm injury. Blackening or tattooing may also be present depending on range.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 18) Blackening and tattooing are related to:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Blackening and tattooing may occur around firearm entry wound. They help in assessing range of firing.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 19) Sharp pointed weapon usually causes:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Stab wound is produced by a sharp pointed weapon. It is deeper than its surface length.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 20) Clean-cut margin is a feature of:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Incised wound is produced by a sharp cutting weapon. It has clean-cut margins and no tissue bridges.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 21) Grievous hurt is defined under:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Section 320 of the BPC defines grievous hurt. It includes eight categories such as emasculation, permanent loss of sight, fracture and dislocation.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 22) Permanent loss of power of procreation is called:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Emasculation means permanent loss of power of procreation. It is one of the grievous hurts under Section 320 BPC.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 23) Permanent privation of sight of either eye is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Permanent loss of sight of either eye is included in grievous hurt. It falls under Section 320 BPC.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 24) Permanent privation of hearing of either ear is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Permanent loss of hearing of either ear is grievous hurt. It is one of the specific categories under Section 320 BPC.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 25) Privation of any member or joint is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Loss of any limb, member or joint is grievous hurt. It has serious permanent functional consequence.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 26) Permanent impairment of powers of any member or joint is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Permanent impairment of function of a limb or joint is grievous hurt. It is different from temporary pain or swelling.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 27) Permanent disfiguration of head or face is classified as:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Permanent disfiguration of head or face is grievous hurt. It is also considered the most elastic provision in grievous hurt.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 28) Fracture of a tooth is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Fracture or dislocation of bone or tooth is grievous hurt. Section 320 BPC specifically includes bone or tooth.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 29) Hurt causing inability to follow ordinary pursuits must last for:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Hurt causing inability to follow ordinary pursuits for 20 days is grievous hurt. Severe bodily pain for this period is also included.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 30) Hurt that endangers life is classified as:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Any hurt that endangers life is grievous hurt. It is one of the categories under Section 320 BPC.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 31) Severe bodily pain for 20 days is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Hurt causing severe bodily pain for 20 days is grievous hurt. The duration and severity make it legally important.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 32) Voluntarily causing grievous hurt is punishable under:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Section 325 BPC deals with punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt. Punishment may include imprisonment and fine.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 33) Grievous hurt caused by dangerous weapons is punishable under:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Section 326 BPC applies when grievous hurt is caused using dangerous weapons, fire, heated substances, poisons or explosives.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 34) Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt may extend up to:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Under Section 325 BPC, voluntarily causing grievous hurt is punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 35) Punishment under Section 326 BPC may extend up to:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Section 326 BPC applies to grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or substances. Punishment may extend up to 10 years and fine.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 36) Grievous hurt caused by poison falls under:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Section 326 BPC covers grievous hurt caused by dangerous weapons, fire, heated substances, poisons and explosives.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 37) The most elastic provision of grievous hurt is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.option4: Permanent disfiguration of head or face
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Permanent disfiguration of head or face is considered the most elastic provision. Its gravity depends on the affected person and impact of disfigurement.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 38) A small permanent facial scar in an actress may be considered:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Permanent facial scar may amount to grievous hurt due to disfiguration. Its importance depends on the person and social impact.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 39) The same small permanent scar may have different medicolegal value depending on:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Disfigurement is elastic because its effect differs by person and social context. The same scar may carry different medicolegal weight.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 40) Irregular torn margin is typical of:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Lacerated wound is caused by blunt force tearing. It usually shows irregular torn margins and tissue bridges.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 41) Sharp cutting weapon produces:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Incised wound is produced by a sharp cutting weapon. Margins are clean-cut and length is greater than depth.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 42) Epidermis removed with scab formation indicates:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Abrasion involves superficial removal of epidermis. Scab formation is a usual feature during healing.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 43) Contusion is another name for:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Bruise is also called contusion. It is caused by blunt force with blood under intact skin.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 44) Gunshot injury is another term for:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Firearm wound means gunshot injury. It may show entry wound, exit wound, abrasion collar, blackening or tattooing.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 45) Depth more than length is seen in:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Stab wound has depth greater than surface length. It is produced by a sharp pointed weapon.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 46) Length more than depth is seen in:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Incised wound is longer than it is deep. It is caused by a sharp cutting weapon.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 47) Tissue bridges are found in:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Tissue bridges are characteristic of laceration. They are absent in true incised wounds.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 48) Absence of tissue bridge supports diagnosis of:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Incised wound has clean-cut margins and no tissue bridges. Tissue bridges indicate tearing by blunt force.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 49) A deep gaping wound with bone cut suggests:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Chop wound is caused by a heavy sharp weapon. It may produce deep gaping injury with bone cut or fracture.

Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.question: 50) Inability to follow ordinary pursuits for 20 days is:
Physical Assult, wound, injury, grievous.exp: Section 320 BPC includes hurt causing inability to follow ordinary pursuits for 20 days. It is one of the categories of grievous hurt.
